coin.title: Dutch Water Defence Lines 10 Euro Coin 2025 Gold Proof (PF66)
coin.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=UI58I2F]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll}The gold commemorative coin for the Dutch Water Defence Lines is now available in a capsule, graded PF66 by the NGC. The coin is well struck with minimal markings and hairlines. The Gold coin comes in a transparent, official NGC case. The mintage is limited to only two coins.
